entities.summary: Kazalla or Kazallu (Ka-zal-luki) is the name given in Akkadian sources to a city in central Mesopotamia whose specific location is unknown. Its patron god was Numushda and his consort Namrat. There are indications that the god Lugal-awak was believed to be located in Kazallu. The city disappears from history with the fall of the Old Babylonian Empire circa 1595 BC.
